lessons.title: Tables and Data Types
lessons.why: Here’s the simple reason this matters: This lesson is about Tables and Data Types. Keep the idea practical: in the PostgreSQL/Supabase data layer, the worked example should show that the table uses types that match the domain: UUID identity, text, boolean state, and timezone-aware timestamps. Once you can explain why that happens, the name is much easier to remember. We connect it to the course project so you can see the idea working instead of memorizing a definition.
